Pima County, AZ
By providing instantaneous review, the SolarAPP+ reduced the average permit review time to less than one day across all five jurisdictions.
The Department of Energy released the results of the pilot project this month in a technical report entitled SolarAPP+ Pilot Analysis: Performance and Impact of Instant, Online Solar Permitting.
SolarApp+ generates a precise list of inspection items simplifying remote inspections for our inspectors and the installers.
